text:
sam: Rolling out FF `llm-route-v4` into prod under deploybot window. Plan: 0% -> 1% (10m) -> 5% (30m) -> 25% (1h). Pin routing to model v4.2.3 for canary. @andre you're oncall for the window. Deploybot will gate on telemetry.

deploybot: starting rollout: llm-route-v4 cohorts=[0,1,5,25] schedule=23:00-03:00PT. Health checks: latency, 5xx rate, p50/p95 token time. Auto-rollback triggers: >=0.5% 5xx over baseline for 10m OR p95 latency >2x baseline for 5m.

mira: quick note - cohort 5 should exclude internal admin traffic (we want clean product metrics).

andre: got it. i'll watch the dashboard. please route alerts to #eng-oncall and page me for criticals.

sre-jen: agree on rollback thresholds. also request a version-lock on the routing config so canary can't drift. add config snippet below for ops: 
```json
{"route":"llm-route-v4","model_version":"v4.2.3","cohorts":[0,1,5,25],"auto_rollback":{"5xx_threshold":0.005,"p95_multiplier":2}}
```

carlos: can we pre-warm caches for v4.2.3? expecting cache-miss spike on first expansion — would rather absorb it before cohort 1. suggest prefetch job ~15m before first cohort.

sam: good call. @deploybot can you run a prewarm task (15m prior)?

deploybot: prewarm task queued -> job-id: prewarm-711111. Will post status here when complete.

deploybot: prewarm: SUCCESS (started 22:40 PT) warmed ~1200 contexts, cache-hit projected +18%.

andre: :thumbsup: i'll mute low-priority noisy alerts (cache thrash) but keep critical 5xx/p95 paged.

sre-jen: operational decision: add a manual holdpoint after cohort 1. If cohort-1 5xx >0.25% for 10m we pause and rollback to model v4.1.9. Otherwise oncall can ACK to continue to 5%.

sam: updated plan: holdpoint after 1% - requires manual ack from oncall or product. who will ack? pls confirm.

mira: i'll ack if product metrics (intent match, latency) look normal.

andre: oncall will ack via `/deploybot ack 711111` if monitoring green. if i don't ack within 15m of holdpoint, deploybot will drain cohorts to 0%.

carlos: post-roll: include perf deltas, cache hit rate, and request distribution in release notes. also flag any increased tail latencies.

sam: copy. i'll publish release notes once rollout completes. runbook link: https://redwood.runbooks/llm-route-v4 

deploybot: rollout status: cohort 0 -> success, cohort 1 -> in progress. posting telemetry to #eng-releases.

sam: thanks team — keeping this thread as the single source for decisions + rollback criteria. :white_check_mark:
